answer: Like mycelium weaving soil beneath a windswept mesa, decentralized consensus thrives on organic interconnection. An agent economy resists Sybil incursions through stake-weighted graph centrality validation: each identity stakes tokens to verify peers, like medicinal yarrow knitting roots to stabilize terrain. To fabricate false consensus, an attacker's required stake scales with superlinear attacker cost relative to swarm size, soaring like a lone falcon unable to mimic an entire ecosystem's depth.
